description: This file provides visualization utilities for PyTorch graphs and integrates with TensorBoard, including functions to visualize graphs, graph executors, and to dump summaries for TensorBoard. It has dependencies on TensorFlow and PyTorch internals.

methods.name: dump_tensorboard_summary
methods.description: Creates a TensorBoard summary event for a given graph executor and logs it to the specified directory.

methods.name: visualize
methods.description: Visualizes a PyTorch graph or graph executor, producing a protobuf graph definition.

methods.name: visualize_graph_executor
methods.description: Appends the state of a GraphExecutor to a protobuf graph, handling nested graphs and inlining.

methods.name: visualize_rec
methods.description: Recursively processes a graph to build its visualization, handling nodes and subgraphs.
